description: "Humboldt" by Robert Green Ingersoll is a biography written in the late 19th century. This work explores the life and achievements of the renowned German naturalist and explorer Alexander von Humboldt, emphasizing his contributions to various scientific fields and his revolutionary ideas about the natural world.
